events.summary: Kentaro appears to Toshusai after aiding him in battle, reveals his identity and challenges him to a test of honor.

events.summary: Through grueling trials Kentaro makes Toshusai confront his dishonor and remember his honor was never lost.
events.quote: helped him remember that his honor had never truly been lost

events.summary: Toshusai passes the test and is welcomed into Kentaro's group of redeemed warriors.
